document.title: Electric Generating Unit Standard Permit Technical Review
document.company: Abilene DC 1, LLC (dba Crusoe Energy Systems, LLC)
document.application_status_as_described: Proposed modification application; this review document does not establish current permit disposition or equipment commissioning status.

literal_quotes.quote: Abilene DC 1, LLC (Abilene DC) dba Crusoe Energy Systems, LLC (Crusoe), has submitted the following modification application for a standard permit for electric generating units for the Longhorn Data Center in Abilene within Taylor County, Texas.
Reduce the count of Titan 350 simple-cycle turbines from six to five and increase the site-rated power to 38 MW per turbine

Reduce the count of GE LM2500 simple-cycle turbines from six to five, reduce the site-rated power to 34.1 MW per turbine, and increase the annual hours of operation from 5,880 hours to 8,760 hours per turbine.
The purpose of the equipment is to generate power for onsite use only for data centers and computing.

claim_boundaries.physical_site_binding: UNVERIFIED: no exact physical-site join to the retained Crusoe/Stargate bridge case has been established. Shared company/city names do not authorize a merge or assigning these supply capacities to that canonical project.
claim_boundaries.supply_capacity: The document states the site-rated power of the proposed onsite generating units: five Titan 350 turbines at 38 MW each and five GE LM2500 turbines at 34.1 MW each. These are generator supply capacities, not temporary load, rental capacity, or a measured grid shortfall.
claim_boundaries.temporary_demand: The permit review does not state temporary/bridge power demand, an unsatisfied utility energization dependency, a temporary supply duration, or a buyer's need for rental generation.
claim_boundaries.contact: No buyer procurement contact or buyer telephone/email method is asserted from this document. Permit reviewer and manager names/signatures are public agency review metadata, not buyer contacts.
claim_boundaries.status: The text identifies a proposed modification application and its received/review dates; current disposition and present operating status remain unknown.
